description: This file defines the KubernetesClusterAgent class, which manages synchronization between Orleans silos and Kubernetes pods. It handles cluster configuration updates, pod monitoring, and pod lifecycle management within a Kubernetes environment, integrating with Orleans cluster membership and lifecycle services.

classes.name: KubernetesClusterAgent
classes.description: Manages synchronization between Orleans cluster state and Kubernetes pods, including monitoring pod lifecycle and cluster membership changes.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the agent to the silo lifecycle to start and stop monitoring.

methods.name: OnStart
methods.description: Initializes the agent, synchronizes cluster state with Kubernetes, and starts monitoring tasks.

methods.name: AddClusterOptionsToPodLabels
methods.description: Ensures the current pod has correct labels reflecting cluster options.

methods.name: OnStop
methods.description: Stops monitoring tasks and cleans up resources.

methods.name: MonitorOrleansClustering
methods.description: Monitors Orleans cluster membership changes and manages corresponding Kubernetes pods.

methods.name: MonitorKubernetesPods
methods.description: Watches Kubernetes pods and updates Orleans cluster state based on pod lifecycle events.

methods.name: TryMatchSilo
methods.description: Matches a Kubernetes pod to an Orleans cluster member.
